description: The seams that give the agent its trees (plan task pod-18, docs/PROOF-RECEIPTS.md): the start tree on the session and the calls that may change files (lib/manager.mjs createAgentSession, #guardCalls), the agent that binds its receipts to them, judges the run against its real final tree and loads a crashed task (lib/agent.mjs #decided, #proved, the tool loop, the run start, #judgeFinalTree, load), judged by tests/verify-proof-receipts.mjs on the real Hub.

mutations.name: PR-no-start-tree
mutations.what: the session carries no start tree

mutations.name: PR-final-tree-ignored
mutations.what: the run's final tree is not looked at

patches.old: try { await this.#judgeFinalTree(task, ended?.tree ?? null); } catch (judgeError) { this.log(this.#redact(judgeError.message)); }

mutations.name: PR-may-change-all
mutations.what: every call is said to change files

patches.old: const mayChangeFiles = scannedCall({ category: decision.category ?? null, touchesWorkspace: this.#touchesWorkspace(name, decision) });

mutations.name: PR-workflow-no-proof
mutations.what: the timeline is not given the trees

mutations.name: PR-agent-no-start-tree
mutations.what: the agent ignores the start tree

mutations.name: PR-agent-no-proofs
mutations.what: the agent keeps no trees of a call

mutations.name: PR-agent-never-scanned
mutations.what: the agent takes no call for one that may change files

patches.old: this.#callTrees(context, call.callId).scanned = typeof info.mayChangeFiles === 'boolean' ? info.mayChangeFiles : scannedCall({ category: info.category });

mutations.name: PR-agent-no-current-tree
mutations.what: a read is not bound to the current tree

mutations.name: PR-load-crash-keeps-tree
mutations.what: a task whose call was running when the Hub died keeps its tree

mutations.name: PR-final-unknown-judges
mutations.what: an unknown tree on either side is judged as a change

mutations.name: PR-final-outcome-kept
mutations.what: the verification outcome is not judged again

mutations.name: PR-final-completion-kept
mutations.what: the completion is not judged again

mutations.name: PR-final-no-warning
mutations.what: the answer does not get the Hub's warning

patches.old: this.#setFinalText(task, { ...task.finalParts, gateNotice: gateNotice(task.proofGate), verificationNotice: evidence.missing.length ? verificationWarning(evidence.missing) : null });

mutations.name: PR-final-no-reason
mutations.what: the event does not say the final tree changed

patches.old: { status: task.status, reason: 'final_tree_changed' }, { missing: task.verificationOutcome.missing, freshness: task.verificationOutcome.freshness });
patches.new: { status: task.status }, { missing: task.verificationOutcome.missing, freshness: task.verificationOutcome.freshness });
